alt: A small powder room viewed from the doorway across five material schemes: deep oxblood walls with marble basin and brass fixtures; forest green zellige with stone and aged nickel; limewashed plaster with travertine and bronze; charcoal micro-cement with black granite and matte black; pale striped wallpaper with white ceramic and polished chrome.
text:
five material worlds, same footprint.

oxblood marble and brass. forest green zellige and aged nickel. limewashed plaster and bronze. charcoal micro-cement and matte black. pale stripes and polished chrome.

in a powder room, every surface shows. small scale means nowhere to hide.
